config firewall address
edit "Prefix-web"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "example.com"
next

edit "Prefix-dns"
set subnet 1.1.1.1 255.255.255.255
next

edit "Prefix-range"
set type iprange
set start-ip 10.0.0.1
set end-ip 10.0.0.9
next

edit "Prefix-cidr"
set subnet 192.168.0.0 255.255.255.0
next

end

config firewall addrgrp
edit "Prefix-Generated Objects"
set member "Prefix-web" "Prefix-dns" "Prefix-range" "Prefix-cidr"
next

end
